source: Simplified bioclimatic starting thresholds based on NBC 2016 Part 11 and ECBC 2017 principles
description: Simplified starting values to be calibrated against historical weather data and official zone maps.

rules.description: Cold winter with mean temp < 10°C and mild summer with max temp < 30°C
Extreme seasons: hot summer (max >= 35°C) and cold winter (min <= 10°C)
Intense summer heat (max >= 35°C), low humidity (< 50%), and arid annual rainfall (< 600 mm)
Warm summer (max >= 28°C), high humidity (>= 60%), and mild/warm winter (mean >= 18°C)
Moderate temperatures and comfortable conditions year-round
